title: "ros2: error: argument ... invalid choice" and "Failed to load entry point" in ROS 2: missing CLI packages, typos, unsourced workspaces and sudo, measured
excerpt: Why ros2 rejects a command with invalid choice, and what Failed to load entry point means instead. Installing ros2controlcli, typos, a workspace command before and after sourcing, broken imports, missing LD_LIBRARY_PATH or PYTHONPATH and sudo, measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
